picks.title: ESP32-WROOM-32E DevKitC
picks.why: The most reliable ESP32 board for beginners. Dual-core 240MHz, Wi-Fi + BT, 4MB flash, USB-C option. Broad community support.

picks.title: ESP32-S3-DevKitC-1
picks.why: For AI/ML edge projects. Adds native USB, more GPIO, vector instructions. Better if you need TinyML or camera work.

picks.title: ESP8266 NodeMCU V3
picks.why: Entry-level Wi-Fi. Single core, limited GPIO, but plenty for simple IoT sensors and no compile-time bloat.

picks.title: Fluke 117 Electrician's Multimeter
picks.why: The gold standard for electrical work. True-RMS, non-contact voltage detection, CAT III 600V. Reliable for 20+ years.

picks.title: Brymen BM235
picks.why: Professional specs at half the Fluke price. True-RMS, high accuracy, excellent build. Favorite of EEVblog community.

picks.title: UNI-T UT61E+
picks.why: Best budget meter with logging. 22,000 count display, USB data output, accurate DC. Common pick for hobbyist labs.

picks.title: TP-Link Kasa EP25 (Matter)
picks.why: Native Matter support, no hub required, energy monitoring. Works with Apple Home, Alexa, Google, and SmartThings.

picks.title: Shelly Plus Plug US
picks.why: Local control, no cloud dependency. Best pick if you run Home Assistant and want full offline operation.

picks.title: Wyze Plug (2-pack)
picks.why: Cheap and reliable for basic on/off automation. No energy monitoring, but great value for 2 plugs.

picks.title: Hakko FX-888D
picks.why: Industry standard for hobby and light professional work. Fast heat-up, accurate temperature, reliable for a decade.

picks.title: Weller WE1010NA
picks.why: Great alternative to Hakko. Excellent ergonomics, quick temperature recovery, ESD-safe. Pick based on availability.

picks.title: Pinecil V2
picks.why: USB-C powered, portable, smart. Open-source firmware. Perfect for students and travelers.

picks.title: Prusa MK4S
picks.why: Best all-rounder. Auto bed leveling, reliable, excellent support. Ships assembled and calibrated.

picks.title: Bambu Lab P1S
picks.why: Enclosed, fast, multi-color with AMS. Best for production runs and ABS/ASA printing.

picks.title: Creality Ender 3 V3 SE
picks.why: Entry-level king. Auto leveling, direct drive, decent quality. Great for learning before upgrading.
